thread:
maria: Quick pass — I'm experimenting with a compact onboarding rail that keeps the setup checklist, sample projects, and quickstart banner all in one narrow column on the right. Trying to reduce cognitive load for first-run. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jon: I like the single-column idea for small screens, but worried about discoverability. People might miss the sample projects if it's collapsed by default.

sasha: Agree with jon. Can we add a small persistent header with a progress chip and a 'Show samples' affordance? Something like: [• Getting started — 2/4] > Show samples

leo: Accessibility nits: color contrast on the progress chip is low at 14px. Also keyboard focus for the sample project cards needs to be a clear outline — currently the focus ring is subtle.

maria: Good points. For discoverability: what if the compact rail auto-expands on first visit for 8s and then collapses? We could record a telemetry event so we don't annoy repeat users. Any concerns about telemetry consent?

jon: Consent is fine as long as we respect the existing telemetry toggle. If we ping for an expansion event, mark it as opt-in only until the consent screen is accepted.

ux-bot: Reminder: per privacy policy, UI-triggered events can be collected after explicit consent. Flagging product-telemetry for a short review.

sasha: Copy suggestions: instead of 'Start here' on the quickstart banner, try 'Try a sample app' — clearer intent. Also change the CTA to 'Create demo project' rather than 'Create project' to reduce friction.

leo: On keyboard nav: sample project list should support arrow key traversal and Enter to open, and provide aria-live updates when a sample imports ("Sample project imported: FinOps dashboard"). Use aria-live="polite".

maria: Implementation idea: collapsed state shows three condensed chips: "Checklist (3) | Samples (5) | Banner". Clicking any chip expands to that pane. That keeps everything discoverable but compact.

jon: Performance concern: the sample imports can trigger heavy background tasks. If we promote sample imports in the rail, make sure we do optimistic UI with a spinner and background queue. Eg: use a lightweight stub and then fetch assets asynchronously.

sasha: UX microcopy tweak for the import modal: top header should say "Create demo workspace" not "Import project". Add a small line: "This will create a sandbox workspace you can delete anytime."

leo: Contrast palette: swap the chip bg to #0F172A at 80% and text to #F8FAFC. Also ensure we don't rely solely on color — add icons + text.

maria: Two quick A/B ideas to test: A) auto-expand-on-first-visit 8s then collapse; B) collapsed-by-default but persistent 'New user spotlight' pulse for 5s. We'll ship both behind flags.

jon: For metrics to evaluate: sample click-through rate, sample import completion rate, time-to-first-API-call from the sample, and drop-off on the import modal.

sasha: Small accessibility QA checklist for the PR: 1) Tab order sanity, 2) 4.5:1 contrast for body text, 3) aria-live messages for import status, 4) screen reader label for the compact rail toggle. I'll add this to the PR comment template.

maria: Awesome — I'll mock up the compact chips and write the copy changes. @sasha can you add the a11y checklist to the PR? @jon can you coordinate with infra on the background import queue?

jon: Yep I will. I'll add a short retry/backoff for asset fetch and surface errors inline ("Import failed — retry").

leo: I'll drop a tiny style token PR for chip contrast and focus styles.

maria: Thanks all — I'll upload the mock screenshots later today. :raised_hands:
